stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"Sorting uses separate sort buttons instead of clickable column heads.","where":"the sort buttons above the table","kind":"taste"}],"liked":[]}

raised: The link "משותף לשלוש, ומה שהנתונים מראים" is unclear: the reader didn't know what it would open.
The bar "מקור · מדריכים · חוקים וכללים…" appears three times, so the reader kept thinking they had scrolled back to the top.
The "לפי חברה / לפי מוצר" toggle is unclear: the reader didn't know what clicking it would change.
Some "במה הכסף מושקע" buttons read as jargon (עוקב מדדים - גמיש, אג"ח ממשלתי סחיר, מט"ח).
Option 2 is too long, and comparing companies means scrolling back and forth.
The "קופה" numbers mean nothing to the reader, and "מתוך ההפקדות" is almost always 0%.
The coloured rings and the exposure dots ("מניות" / "מט"ח" percentages) are unclear.
The clock icons and dotted underlines are unclear: the reader couldn't tell whether they were clickable.
The reader didn't understand what "חשיפה מט"ח 99%" means for their money.
"פחות מ־3 שנים" is not explained, so the reader had to guess.
The difference between "עוד לא דווח", "חדש" and "—" in the grid is unclear.
Returns are shown before fees, so the reader had to subtract the fee themselves.
"ממוצע 2025" is unclear: an average of what, and what fee will the reader actually pay?
Return after fees is missing.
A shekel example of the fee difference over time is missing.
How much a track lost in a bad year is missing.
Whether the fee can be negotiated down is missing.
How to move money between companies, and the cost or tax effect of moving, is missing.
What happens at 60 and over (monthly pension, tax rules) is missing.
There is no information about customer service.
The reader would drop half of the "במה הכסף מושקע" buttons (types with few tracks).

problems.why: The reader only noticed the "מיון לפי" control and said they didn't need it; they never complained about sort buttons being used instead of clickable column headings.
